summary: Orchid Island Capital filed a routine Form 8-K on September 14, 2026, announcing a monthly cash dividend of $0.10 per common share payable October 29, 2026 to holders of record September 30, 2026, ex-dividend the same date, alongside August 31, 2026 RMBS portfolio characteristics; the next dividend announcement is expected October 14, 2026. No special-situation transaction, strategic action, or abrupt management change is disclosed. The filing is an ordinary dividend and portfolio update, with no deal terms, advisors, or structural mechanics. What to watch: monthly RMBS prepayment speeds, book value and leverage disclosure, and dividend coverage given the REIT's agency-MBS carry model.
